roster_note: Barrack rows, vehicle sheds, parade ground.
residential_program: a two-storey brick row of repeated single-room dwellings
external stair flights serving the upper doors directly
a shared yard behind with outbuildings, a standpipe and a latrine block
a stove flue per dwelling rising through the roof
a coal or fuel store at each end of the row
circulation: every dwelling is entered from outside; there is no internal corridor
external stairs land on a real walkway, not in open air
damage_constraints: one bay of the row has collapsed, exposing the party walls either side
the external stairs and the yard route survive
derive all damage and occupation only from the immutable clean master
use an authored fracture with a gravity-consistent rubble apron, never a cleared box and never per-block random deletion

required_manual_checks: the row reads as many small dwellings, not one long building
the stove flue rhythm is regular and matches the dwelling count
